definitions.ask: With no working mmdc installed, should the check fall back to `npx -y -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc`?
definitions.why: Mirrors the audio macro's `uvx sase-listen` fallback, so diagrams need no setup

choices.label: Works for anyone with Node 22.13+; first run downloads mermaid-cli and Chrome (~150 MB)
Uses only a pre-installed working mmdc; never downloads, otherwise diagrams fail
